# Setup Cleanup

This page tells what `claudetto-setup` removes from the settings that `claudetto` 0.3.0-alpha.1 wrote.
The cleanup runs before the merge of the snippet, in the same command (see [Setup](Setup)).

## What the Cleanup Removes

| Entry | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `Bash(rm -rf /*)` in `permissions.deny` | The `*` also matches a delete in `/tmp`, such as `rm -rf /tmp/x`. |
| `Bash(rm -rf ~/*)` in `permissions.deny` | The `*` also matches a delete under the home folder, such as `rm -rf ~/proj/build`. |

The `guard` slice still denies a delete of `/`, `~`, and `$HOME`.
The cleanup lists each rule that it removes, and leaves each other rule of the user.

## Older Versions

Setup no longer removes the keys of 0.1.0 and 0.2.0.
To update from one of these versions, run the setup of 0.3.0-alpha.1 first.
